interpretation_en: denotes wealth and the total absence of refinement

cite.original: To see a large paunch, denotes wealth and the total absence of refinement.
cite.translation_ko: 큰 똥배를 보는 꿈은, 부유하나 기품이 전혀 없다는 조짐이다

cite.original: To see a shriveled paunch, foretells illness and reverses.
cite.translation_ko: 쪼그라든 똥배를 보는 꿈은, 병과 역경을 알리는 조짐이다

cite.original: To dream that you are a pauper, implies unpleasant happenings for you.
cite.translation_ko: 제가 극빈자임을 꿈꾸면, 언짢은 일이 생길 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that there will be a call upon your generosity

cite.original: To see paupers, denotes that there will be a call upon your generosity.
cite.translation_ko: 극빈자들을 보는 꿈은, 베풂을 청할 일이 생길 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 깨어 있을 때 실망과 손실을 겪을 조짐
interpretation_en: you will find disappointments and losses in your waking moments

cite.original: If in your dreams you enter a pawn-shop, you will find disappointments and losses in your waking moments.
cite.translation_ko: 전당포에 들어가는 꿈은, 깨어 있을 때 실망과 손실을 겪을 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 아내나 애인과 언짢은 일을 겪고 사업에서도 실망할 조짐
interpretation_en: you will have unpleasant scenes with your wife or sweetheart, and perhaps disappointments in business

cite.original: To pawn articles, you will have unpleasant scenes with your wife or sweetheart, and perhaps disappointments in business.
cite.translation_ko: 물건을 전당 잡히는 꿈은, 아내나 애인과 언짢은 일을 겪고 사업에서도 실망할 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 경솔한 짓을 저지르고 벗을 잃어 뉘우칠 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that she is guilty of indiscretions, and she is likely to regret the loss of a friend

cite.original: For a woman to go to a pawn-shop, denotes that she is guilty of indiscretions, and she is likely to regret the loss of a friend.
cite.translation_ko: 여성이 전당포에 가는 꿈은, 경솔한 짓을 저지르고 벗을 잃어 뉘우칠 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that you will regain lost positions

cite.original: To redeem an article, denotes that you will regain lost positions.
cite.translation_ko: 전당 잡힌 물건을 되찾는 꿈은, 잃었던 자리를 되찾을 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 믿음을 소홀히 하여 추잡한 일로 명예를 잃을 위험에 처했다는 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes you are negligent of your trust and are in danger of sacrificing your honorable name in some salacious affair

cite.original: To dream that you see a pawn-shop, denotes you are negligent of your trust and are in danger of sacrificing your honorable name in some salacious affair.
cite.translation_ko: 전당포를 보는 꿈은, 믿음을 소홀히 하여 추잡한 일로 명예를 잃을 위험에 처했다는 조짐이다
